annotations.title: Pay for a held capability result

description: Pay for a part result held as locked and get all of it. It pays from the key's call credits, else its balance within its spending limits (one source per call, never split). When neither covers it the reply says what each holds, how much is missing and how to add it (balance_topup_link for a person, key_prepaid with agent_key for USDC, spend_limits_set for the limits) with pay_link for a person to pay exactly this result, and next is this same unlock. A call that failed answers call_failed at once with what happened. A result held longer than 72 hours closes unpaid; call the part again with a new idempotency_key. With a review window the result comes back in_review.

agent_key.description: The key that made the call.
